sv.title: ”Man fattar ju om Blåvitt har fått nog”
sv.summary: ”Man fattar ju om Blåvitt fått nog”, skriver GP:s Sanna Sundberg efter IFK Göteborgs förlust mot guldjagande Hammarby.

en.title: “You can tell if Blåvitt has had enough”
en.summary: “You can tell if Blåvitt has had enough”, writes GP's Sanna Sundberg after IFK Göteborg's loss to title-chasing Hammarby.
